en.html:
The temple to which the girl walked ahead and led me could be called neither especially famous nor especially grand. Even so, it was without doubt one of the proud old temples of Kamakura.

Worshippers there were none. Not even a monk could be seen. It could not be that nobody lived there... but its deserted look was enough to make even that believable.

Perhaps because the first-ranked Kenchouji of the Kamakura Five Mountains, the second-ranked Engakuji and the fourth-ranked Jouchiji stand lined up right nearby. Few people seemed to come and go here, even on ordinary days.
